#include <climits>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int,int> ii;

const int INF = 1e9;

struct MinCostFlow {
    int n;
    vector<int> prio, curflow, prevedge, prevnode, pot;
    struct Edge {
        int to, f, cap, cost, rev;
    };
    vector<vector<Edge>> adj;
    
    MinCostFlow(int n) : n(n), prio(n), curflow(n), prevedge(n), prevnode(n), pot(n), adj(n) {}
    
    void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
        Edge a = {t, 0, cap, cost, (int)adj[t].size()};
        Edge b = {s, 0, 0, -cost, (int)adj[s].size()};
        adj[s].push_back(a);
        adj[t].push_back(b);
    }
    
    pair<int,int> minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0, flowCost = 0;
        priority_queue<pair<ll,int>, vector<pair<ll,int>>, greater<pair<ll,int>>> pq;
        while (flow < INF) {
            fill(prio.begin(), prio.end(), INT_MAX);
            prio[s] = 0;
            curflow[s] = INT_MAX;
            pq.push({0, s});
            while (!pq.empty()) {
                auto cur = pq.top(); pq.pop();
                ll d = cur.first;
                int u = cur.second;
                if (d != prio[u]) continue;
                for (Edge &e : adj[u]) {
                    if (e.cap <= e.f) continue;
                    int v = e.to;
                    int nprio = prio[u] + e.cost + pot[u] - pot[v];
                    if (prio[v] > nprio) {
                        prio[v] = nprio;
                        pq.push({(ll)nprio, v});
                        prevnode[v] = u;
                        prevedge[v] = &e - &adj[u][0];
                        curflow[v] = min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (prio[t] == INT_MAX) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) pot[i] += prio[i];
            int df = min(curflow[t], INF - flow);
            flow += df;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                Edge &e = adj[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
                e.f += df;
                adj[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                flowCost += df * e.cost;
            }
        }
        return {flow, flowCost};
    }
};

int n, m, k, c, d;

    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false); cin.tie(0); cout.tie(0);
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    MinCostFlow nt(6 + 107 * n);
    for (int _ = 0; _ < k; _++) {
        int x; cin >> x; x--;
        nt.addEdge(0, 1 + x, 1, 0);
    }
